name: Contact
description: A supplier, customer or other business relation: identity, address, bank details, payment terms and the people behind it.

global.schema:
type ContactState {
  name: String
  kind: ContactKind!
  status: ContactStatus!
  email: String
  phone: String
  website: String
  vatId: String
  registrationNumber: String
  address: PostalAddress!
  bank: BankDetails!
  paymentTermsDays: Int!
  defaultCategory: TransactionCategory!
  tags: [String!]!
  people: [ContactPerson!]!
  notes: String
}

type PostalAddress {
  street: String
  postalCode: String
  city: String
  country: String
}

type BankDetails {
  iban: String
  bic: String
  accountHolder: String
}

type ContactPerson {
  id: OID!
  name: String!
  role: String
  email: String
  phone: String
}

enum ContactKind {
  SUPPLIER
  CUSTOMER
  BOTH
  OTHER
}

enum ContactStatus {
  ACTIVE
  ARCHIVED
}

enum TransactionCategory {
  UNCATEGORIZED
  SALES
  SUPPLIES
  PAYROLL
  RENT
  SOFTWARE
  TRAVEL
  MARKETING
  TAX
  BANK_FEES
  TRANSFER
  OTHER
}
global.initialValue: {"name": null, "kind": "SUPPLIER", "status": "ACTIVE", "email": null, "phone": null, "website": null, "vatId": null, "registrationNumber": null, "address": {"street": null, "postalCode": null, "city": null, "country": null}, "bank": {"iban": null, "bic": null, "accountHolder": null}, "paymentTermsDays": 30, "defaultCategory": "UNCATEGORIZED", "tags": [], "people": [], "notes": null}

operations.name: SET_PROFILE
operations.schema:
input SetProfileInput {
  name: String
  kind: ContactKind
  email: String
  phone: String
  website: String
  vatId: String
  registrationNumber: String
  notes: String
}

operations.name: SET_ADDRESS
SET_BANK_DETAILS
SET_PAYMENT_TERMS

errors.name: InvalidTermsError
errors.description: Payment terms must be zero or more days

operations.name: ADD_TAG
REMOVE_TAG
ADD_PERSON
operations.schema:
input AddPersonInput {
  id: OID!
  name: String!
  role: String
  email: String
  phone: String
}

operations.name: UPDATE_PERSON
operations.schema:
input UpdatePersonInput {
  id: OID!
  name: String
  role: String
  email: String
  phone: String
}

operations.name: REMOVE_PERSON
ARCHIVE_CONTACT

errors.name: StatusUnchangedError
errors.description: The contact already has that status
